children: Overview
Hong Kong printing services firm's H1 revenue fell 32% yr/yr on weaker demand and lower prices
Results reflect challenging market conditions in Hong Kong and contraction in Mainland China
Outlook
Company expects traditional printing operations to maintain steady performance but sees no recovery in core market
Result Drivers
WEAK DEMAND AND PRICING - Co said revenue decline was mainly due to reduced demand and downward pressure on prices for printing services
CHINA OPERATIONS CONTRACT - Co said operations in Mainland China contracted amid market headwinds and intense competition
COST MANAGEMENT - Co said previous restructuring, including closure of Tsing Yi site, created a leaner cost structure
